answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain network weight. Like a vine choking out parasitic growth, this economic friction renders a fable of infinite identities unprofitable. Each identity requires a cost measured in capital, turning the quill of the developer into a ledger of verifiable stake. An attacker incurs direct losses proportional to the number of nodes deployed, effectively pricing out bulk manipulation.
